title: Agentic software development and the reality gap
purpose: Test whether a local model can synthesize five source-separated evidence cards and three personal thoughts into an accurate, useful German LinkedIn post about coding-agent value and its conditions.

output.audience: Software leaders, developers and technically interested professional readers
output.format: One evidence-grounded LinkedIn post with short paragraphs

strengths: Directly represents the user's professional interest in coding-agent deployment
Requires reconciliation of autonomous benchmarks, human productivity evidence and organizational research
Separates empirical evidence from user-authored professional perspective
Tests system-level reasoning about model, harness, verification and work context
limitations: English evidence and German output combine synthesis with cross-lingual writing
The project selects and paraphrases evidence before candidate generation, so this case does not evaluate online research or source selection
LinkedIn suitability remains partly subjective and therefore requires a rubric-grounded judge
One post cannot establish a stable distribution of writing quality
